assertions.reference: refund processing timeline and business days

context: Refunds are processed within 3-5 business days after approval.
Returns must be initiated within 30 days of purchase.
Digital products are non-refundable after 7 days.

input: How do I enable two-factor authentication?

context: Two-factor authentication can be enabled from Settings > Security > 2FA.
Supported methods include SMS, authenticator apps, and hardware keys.
After enabling 2FA, you will need to verify on every new device login.

input: What are the shipping costs for international orders?

assertions.reference: international shipping rates and delivery fees

context: International shipping starts at $15 for standard delivery.
Express international shipping costs $35-50 depending on the destination.
Free shipping is available for orders over $200 to select countries.
Customs duties are the responsibility of the buyer.

input: Can I use the API without authentication?

context: All API endpoints require authentication via Bearer token.
Rate limits are 100 requests per minute for authenticated users.
Public endpoints are read-only and limited to 10 requests per minute.
API keys can be generated from the Developer Dashboard.

input: What programming languages does the SDK support?

assertions.reference: supported programming languages and SDK availability

context: Official SDKs are available for Python, JavaScript, Ruby, and PHP.
Community SDKs exist for Go, Rust, and Java.
The PHP SDK requires PHP 8.1 or later.

input: How do I handle rate limiting?

context: When rate limited, the API returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header.
Implement exponential backoff starting at 1 second.
Premium plans have higher rate limits of 1000 requests per minute.
Batch endpoints are not subject to per-request rate limits.

input: What data formats are supported for import?

context: Supported import formats include CSV, JSON, and JSONL.
Maximum file size for imports is 100MB.
CSV files must include a header row.
Automatic backups run daily at 2:00 AM UTC.
Backups are retained for 30 days on the Pro plan.
You can trigger a manual backup from Settings > Data > Backups.
Backup restoration takes approximately 15 minutes.
